title: Membrane Governance Contract
description: Agnostic rule data governing restoration-agent behaviour. Per-agent adapters compile this to a harness hook surface. Mirrors the CyberneticCodePilot governator contract: rules are data, enforcement is a thin per-vendor shim.

mode.description: advisory = log the fire + inject a nudge, never block (paved-paths-before-teeth, and safe for the maintainer's own server testing). enforce = apply `outcome` to halt/steer. Flip a single rule advisory->enforce once the fire-log shows the paving holds.

type.description: Evaluator class. command = cheap deterministic match (this adapter). prompt/agent = LLM/semantic supervision. http = POST hook input to an endpoint.

outcome.description: Applied ONLY when mode=enforce; ignored under advisory.

law.description: Which PROCEDURE.md law this enforces (navigate-not-scan | slice-not-slurp | edit-not-regenerate | finish-clean).

tool.description: '|'-alternated harness tool names, or '*' for any. Matched against the tool name.

arg.description: '|'-alternated globs, or '*' for any. Matched against the tool's primary argument: the command string for Bash/PowerShell, the file path for Read/Write/Edit. Paths are '/'-normalized before matching.

message.description: Steering text injected back to the agent — the 'errors are steering' channel. Names the correct next move, never just 'denied'.
